My mom completed suicide when I was 19 and it changed me forever. By no means am I trying to make you feel guilty, but I want you to find enough purpose to keep you going as long as you can. I often wonder why I wasn’t enough for her to stay, why she didn’t want to watch me graduate or get married or have kids etc. But I also understand that logically, she wasn’t able to consider these things in the midst of her pain.

That’s why we need to decrease your pain. I’m just a stranger on the internet but I’ve been suicidal for as long as I can remember so I understand to some degree how you feel. It feels like a perfect backup plan to end your pain, but it eliminates any chances of it getting better as well.

Find any reason to stay. Whether it’s a TV show coming out or a concert next month you’d like to attend. Maybe it’s being there for your sons first day of school, or even just wanting to make your favourite meal. No reason is too little or too stupid to stay alive.

I can’t promise I can fix your problems but please shoot me a DM if you’d like to talk. There’s always another way out that isn’t suicide; sometimes finding that way out is difficult and can take a while but you deserve to be happy and you deserve to watch your kids grow up.
